sources.role: Independent shoreline comparison family; selected full-resolution records only

license.terms: LGPL version 3 or later, as recorded in the source extraction manifest.

sources.restoration: Use the pinned selected-record bytes and extraction manifest in source-pins.json and the macro-coverage source packet. Do not substitute another GSHHG release into this comparison.
sources.limit: A generalized comparison coastline is not an authoritative modern shoreline or legal boundary; component disagreement remains unresolved.

methods.description: Execute the exact pinned #1292 producer and area helper against immutable index, source and archived-report blobs; redirect its fixed writes into a private, newly admitted output stage; compare the resulting whole reports against the retained #1292 outputs.
methods.software: CPython 3.12.14; NumPy 2.3.5; Shapely 2.1.2; GEOS 3.13.1; shared WorldAtlas NewVintage v1
methods.units: EPSG:4326 longitude,latitude; WGS84 ellipsoid area in km²; fractions are covered/source union area or component counts
methods.area_method: WGS84 ellipsoid integral for straight longitude/latitude edges using the pinned scripts/ellipsoidal_area.py; no snapping, buffering, repair or clipping

conclusions.text: Two fresh safe executions reproduce both retained #1292 report files byte-for-byte for the pinned 9be99df snapshot; the listed overlap metrics describe indexed representation only.
The pinned OSM/GSHHG disagreement does not establish present-day shoreline completeness, legal boundaries, a source crosswalk, parent approval, an importable footprint, or publication authorization.
